resources.string: Images and video across phones
Use several phones together to make images and videos. One phone is the Main device (master); the others lend their memory as helpers.
Lend this phone\'s memory (Helper)
Let another phone use this one\'s memory and processor while it makes images or video.
Open helper
Helper phone (media)
Lend this phone\'s memory to the Main device for images and video.
On the other phones, open Helper and tap Start sharing.
On this phone, open Main device and add those helpers.
Choose a model, write a prompt and start.
Choose how much memory to lend and tap Start sharing.
On the Main device, add this phone using the address shown below.
Keep this phone on the same Wi-Fi as the Main device while it works.
Add the helpers that are sharing their memory.
Choose how the work is split. Automatic memory plan is a good default.
Pick a model and a prompt, then start the run.
Start a run on the Main device.
